cause_chain.observation: Existing test wraps a semantic Equation in empty Styled and no snapshot to model a historically supported query view.
Actual realized producer captures numbering, number-align, supplement and alt in an unmarked Styled over the original entry content, stored with fields=None at lines163–166.
Native Equation selector intentionally still traverses Styled; identity matches.
Native filter lookup delegates Equation Styled fields to get_field; new getter requires own constructor marker, so block/body/options disappear.
None snapshot uses legacy field projection and causes failed where filters. Some snapshot is authoritative.

options.option: Complete realized snapshot on existing semantic Equation
options.assessment: Preferred smallest complete producer correction, pending current-pin measurements and L0 decision. No public entity/signature/mode/phase change is required. Store original semantic Content plus ordered Some fields, following existing snapshot contract rather than misusing constructor provenance. Include effective block/body and four captured options with original values; present causal label last; no func/location. Preserve existing snapshot semantics deliberately.
options.caution: queries.rs:112 disables legacy label-index fallback for every Some snapshot. A six-field snapshot without the causal label introduces a new label filter regression. ElementInfo.label is available on each input Tag::Start; do not reconstruct from arbitrary selector or first occurrence. Existing selector fixture should exercise the actual producer boundary and retain match/miss/alias/snapshot assertions, not simply be labelled stale.

options.assessment: Technically possible only with new explicit private provenance contract and coordinated recognizer/nucleus updates. It must not overload equation.constructor. Broader owner surface than snapshot approach; does not by itself establish complete known-field snapshot semantics.

Can restore historical where filter outcome without reopening ordinary reflection, but incomplete alone: realized entries still expose styled identity/serialization. Requires explicit selector L0 responsibility and current-pin evidence; not a complete repair of producer morphology.

measurement_gap: Existing 173 source corpus has no realized Equation query cases; constructor and external-style observations do not certify this producer. Parent-controlled supplemental current-pin query/native-where/block/body/options/label/func and JSON/YAML probes needed before accepting repair.
recommended_controls: Actual realize_equation_elements producer through native Equation and alias filter; block/body/options known values and negative mismatch.
Two occurrences with different captured values and causal labels; label filter preserved after snapshot introduction.
Some(empty) and Some(divergent) remain authoritative at consumer boundary; no per-field fallback.
Ordinary external Styled remains opaque to reflected Equation fields and constructor marker does not appear.
Query fields/func/native identity and JSON/YAML output on realized Equation; callbacks not reexecuted during observation.
